item.title: Cost of Living in Kingsville Melbourne
item.description:
Money matters when you’re choosing where to live. Here’s the real story on costs in Kingsville — no sugar-coating, no made-up figures.

Read our full Kingsville suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Kingsville Expensive?

Kingsville sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Kingsville, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Kingsville — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every Melbourne suburb has a story. Kingsville’s story is one of working-class roots that have given way to a creative, gentrified present. Understanding that history explains why the suburb feels the way it does today.

What Kingsville Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Kingsville was originally a working-class neighbourhood. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.
